device_name: Tritanium X PL Expandable Posterior Lumbar Cage, Tritanium X TL Expandable Curved Posterior Lumbar Cage
device_name_fda: Tritanium X PL Expandable Posterior Lumbar Cage, Tritanium X TL Expandable Curved Posterior Lumbar Cage
what_it_is:
The Tritanium TL is a Curved interbody spacer for use in the TLIF procedure and is made from Styker patented additive 3D printing to create a high porous internal structure. The curved banana cage has an articulating inserter to make anterior disc space placement easier.

Features:
- 3D printed titanium with high porous architecture with 55-65% porosity
- Steerable inserter
- Footprint options:
- 10x27mm
- 10x31mm
- 10x35mm
- Lordosis options:
- 0 degree
- 6 degree
- 12 degree
- Height options:
- 7-14mm
